'''Alysa''' is the widow of [[Graeger]] and sister of [[Almen Bunt]].

==Appearance==
She has dark hair.

==Activities==
She owns a large apple orchard near [[Dragonmount]]. She relies on her two sons and brother, Almen, to rescue her orchard.

==Trivia==
Alysa is named after Alisa Harris, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
